Scaling —————————————————————–

#separate data frame to scale numerical variables
myData_select<-myData %>% select(26:37)
myData_select<-scale(myData_select)
myData_select<-as.data.frame(myData_select,header=TRUE, row.names=1)

#join dataframes
myData<- myData[,-c(27:37)] 
myData<-cbind(myData,myData_select)

#scaling infiltration
Datainf$infiltrationlog<-scale(Datainf$infiltrationlog)

#scaling compaction
Datacomp$compactionlog<-scale(Datacomp$compactionlog)

Bayesian models specifications ———————————————————

# Define options for the NUTS sampler
nchains <- 4    # number of chains (at least 4 for NUTS sampling)
niter <- 10000   # number of iterations per chain
nwarm <- 5000   # number of iterations to warm up before sampling 
#4 x (10000-5000)= 20000 iterations

Burrow models dry season ——————————————————————

ph

#ph
fitGLMM1_burrow <- brm(pHlog ~ + B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM1_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: pHlog ~ +B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 50) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.84      0.32     0.37     1.61 1.00     6030     7992
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                         -0.10      0.71    -1.49     1.29 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                          0.13      0.58    -1.02     1.25 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                     0.10      1.03    -1.94     2.11 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous               0.16      1.01    -1.83     2.15 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                 0.15      1.01    -1.85     2.16 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          -0.14      0.83    -1.77     1.49 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    -0.29      0.81    -1.86     1.29 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      -0.04      0.83    -1.68     1.58 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          9560    11502
## B.or.NBNB                         10484    13607
## Grass.typeArid                    10189    12185
## Grass.typeCalcareous              10679    11998
## Grass.typeMountain                10164    10837
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          12277    13651
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    12541    13074
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      12541    13466
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.87      0.11     0.68     1.12 1.00    12429    13757
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
pHlog1_D2<-fitGLMM1_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
pHlog1_D2

#obtaining ROPE (REGION OF PRACTICAL EQUIVALENCE)
fitglmm1.rg<-(ref_grid(fitGLMM1_burrow)) # having an emmgrid from the model 
ropeph1<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm1.rg, pairwise~Grass.type), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!!
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
ropeph2<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm1.rg, pairwise~B.or.NB), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!! 
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
ropeph3<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm1.rg, pairwise~B.or.NB:Grass.type), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!! 
ropeph1

fitGLMM2_burrow <- brm(conductivitylog ~ + B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM2_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: conductivitylog ~ +B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 50) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
##

## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.77      0.24     0.45     1.37 1.00     6499     9754
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.68      0.48    -0.27     1.63 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.02      0.16    -0.33     0.29 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                     0.29      0.68    -1.08     1.65 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -0.53      0.68    -1.90     0.84 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -1.55      0.69    -2.92    -0.19 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          -0.29      0.22    -0.72     0.15 1.00

## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      -0.33      0.22    -0.78     0.11 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          9679    10063

## Grass.typeArid                     9629    10229
## Grass.typeCalcareous              10750    10728

## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          15473    13983

condlog1_D2<-fitGLMM2_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "conductivity scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
condlog1_D2

fitGLMM4_burrow <- brm(Klog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM4_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: Klog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 50) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
##

## ~ID (Number of levels: 12)

##

##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.02      0.47    -0.91     0.95 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.27      0.29    -0.85     0.30 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                    -0.32      0.67    -1.64     0.99 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous               0.40      0.67    -0.92     1.72 1.00

## Intercept                         10353    10834

Klog1_D2<-fitGLMM4_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "K scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Klog1_D2

fitGLMM7_burrow <- brm(P.TUDlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM7_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: P.TUDlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 50) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.76      0.29     0.35     1.45 1.00     5692     9320
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          1.23      0.62     0.01     2.45 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.45      0.48    -1.40     0.49 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                    -1.54      0.88    -3.26     0.19 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -1.34      0.88    -3.05     0.40 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -0.83      0.87    -2.54     0.88 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          -0.13      0.68    -1.46     1.22 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous     0.30      0.66    -1.01     1.61 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain       0.07      0.67    -1.25     1.38 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          8568    10813
## B.or.NBNB                          9706    11440
## Grass.typeArid                     9179    10330
## Grass.typeCalcareous               9629    11807
## Grass.typeMountain                 9489    11230
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          11710    12747
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    11282    12698

## Family Specific Parameters:

Plog1_D2<-fitGLMM7_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "P scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Plog1_D2

fitGLMM9_burrow <- brm(TNlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM9_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity

##          total post-warmup draws = 20000

TNlog1_D2<-fitGLMM9_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "TN scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
TNlog1_D2

  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Infiltration scaled" )+

  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")

  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +

  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
